purpose: 在扩大步态前比较足部校准 FK 与二维关键姿态绘制。
scope: 同一认可人物、同一相机、同一显示尺寸；只验证四个足部支撑关键姿态。

poses.label: 脚跟着地
poses.support: 前脚跟先接触，后脚趾仍可见

poses.label: 全脚支撑
requiredEvidence: 重心投影落在接触面内

poses.label: 前掌承重
poses.support: 后跟抬起，前掌与趾承重
requiredEvidence: 鞋底没有侧边代替前掌接地

poses.label: 趾离地
poses.support: 支撑脚结束，另一脚进入摆动
requiredEvidence: 躯干和头部不冻结在旧位置

routes.method: 保留来源骨盆、膝肘曲线；重新建立目标鞋、脚、趾的静止轴和局部滚动链
stopIf: 任一支撑姿态鞋底侧倾超过 5°
脚踝方向与膝向不一致
必须逐帧移动骨盆才能接地

trial.mode: relative source-rest to target-rest foot rotation
trial.result: failed; simple rest-frame calibration does not establish support contact

routes.method: 沿用现有二维分层母版，直接绘制四张完整姿态，再检查是否需要局部姿态修绘
mustInspect: 整数像素轮廓与接触阴影
stopIf: 脚底只能靠阴影伪造接触
插值前关键姿态本身已不成立

trial.result: four static poses exported; visual review pending full-body acceptance

releaseGate: 四姿态均由完整人物自行审看通过
正面、侧面、俯视和实际显示尺寸均通过
未使用最低顶点、关节角或渲染可重复性替代视觉验收
decision: same-view full-body surface-motion candidate built; complete painted gait and natural walking remain unapproved

currentEvidence.raster: full-pose paint roundtrip proven; 13-frame articulated weight transfer packaged; no complete walk approval

transitionTrial.failure: Existing contact assertion combines a single anchor with the whole shoe bounding box; toe-roll frame penetrates despite the anchor adjustment.
transitionTrial.decision: Separate heel, forefoot and toe contact patches before another transition export.

transitionTrialIsolation.finding: With root travel fixed, contact checks were isolated, but intermediate frames still cross legs and lose credible weight transfer.
transitionTrialIsolation.decision: Author intermediate weight-transfer keyposes; do not fill leg motion from endpoint contour interpolation.

currentControl.result: internal-control-only; rigid upper and sampled cloth do not prove full-pose art

fullPosePaintTrial.result: engineering-roundtrip-proven; silhouette changes supported; art not approved
